name: io.github.pavellunev/appmetrica-mcp
description: AppMetrica (Yandex) analytics: reports, funnels, segments, dashboards, logs export, push

environmentVariables.name: APPMETRICA_OAUTH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Yandex OAuth token with AppMetrica scope; optional when `npx appmetrica-mcp auth` saved credentials

environmentVariables.name: APPMETRICA_ALLOW_WRITE
environmentVariables.description: Set to "true" to enable write tools (funnels, segments, push campaigns, web workspaces)

environmentVariables.name: APPMETRICA_WORKSPACES_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path of the local JSON file with saved dashboard widget sets (default ~/.config/appmetrica-mcp/workspaces.json)

environmentVariables.name: APPMETRICA_BROWSER_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Chrome profile directory for the experimental web session (default ~/.config/appmetrica-mcp/chrome-profile)

environmentVariables.name: APPMETRICA_BROWSER_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to a Chrome/Chromium executable for the experimental web session (default: system Google Chrome)

environmentVariables.name: APPMETRICA_BROWSER_CHANNEL
environmentVariables.description: Playwright browser channel for the experimental web session (chrome | chromium | msedge; default chrome)

environmentVariables.name: APPMETRICA_BROWSER_IDLE_MS
environmentVariables.description: Idle time after which the headless web session closes Chrome and frees the profile (default 120000)

environmentVariables.name: APPMETRICA_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Your own Yandex OAuth app ClientID for `appmetrica-mcp auth` (default: bundled public app)
